question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

xy_z_xxy_zbx_yx_bx_y_z_x
solution:
Given series: xy_z_xxy_zbx_yx_bx_y_z_x

So, checking each option one by one:

Option 1) xzxxyyzx →xy__x__z__b__xxy__x__zbx__x__yx__z__bx__x__y__x__z__b__x → (It doesn't follows any pattern)

Option 2) xyxxzxxb →xy__x__z__b__xxy__x__zbx__x__yx__z__bx__x__y__x__z__b__x → (It doesn't follows any pattern)

Option 3) xbxxzxxb →xy__**x**__z__**b**__xxy__**x**__zbx__**x**__yx__**z**__bx__**x**__y__**x**__z__**b**__x →** (It follows the pattern of: xyxzbx - xyxzbx - xyxzbx - xyxzbx)**

Option 4) xbxyzxxb →xy__x__z__b__xxy__x__zbx__x__yx__z__bx__x__y__x__z__b__x → (It doesn't follows any pattern)

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.
